title: Bandstand layout and the ASCAP-BMI strike
summary: The bandstand is moved to the middle the next year, and they remember the ASCAP strike, BMI and the song 'Because of You'.

story.theme_name: Getting paid for records: royalties, publishing and flat fees
story.community_name: Royalties, publishing and who owns the song

blocks.x: The band opened up -- the way the Club was built, the bandstand was at the west end of the --
Pavillion. Used to GET ALL the dances in the Pavillion Ballroom.

That's right, and so the next year, they changed it and put the bandstand in the middle, see. And this gave it a little more balance. But it was kind of hard playing back here. And I do remember that that was the year of the big strike of the composers. ASCAP struck, you know.
And BMI come out. And this piece -- the record that TAP Smith made --
"Because of You was written by a colored girl from Ohio. I can't think of her name. Because of You." *[Una Mae Carlisle]-ed.
